channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: I met a girl at a club the other night & she told me she'd show me a good time.
item.description:
I met a girl at a club the other night & she told me she'd show me a good time.
When we got outside, she ran a 40 yard dash in 4.8 seconds.

item.title: What did Yoda say when he saw himself in 4K?
item.description:
What did Yoda say when he saw himself in 4K?
"HDMI"

item.title: What do you call a test tube full of gross liquid?
item.description:
What do you call a test tube full of gross liquid?
A vile vial.

item.title: What is a stinky chicken?
item.description:
What is a stinky chicken?
A foul fowl.

item.title: What is a quick look at a mountaintop?
item.description:
What is a quick look at a mountaintop?
A peak peek.

item.title: What do you call bunny fur?
item.description:
What do you call bunny fur?
Hare hair.

item.title: What do you call a scared bucket?
item.description:
What do you call a scared bucket?
A pale pail.

item.title: What do you say to a soldier in shining armor when he goes to bed?
item.description:
What do you say to a soldier in shining armor when he goes to bed?
Night-night, Knight!

item.title: What do you call a young coal digger?
item.description:
What do you call a young coal digger?
A minor miner.

item.title: How did the moose begin the letter to his cousin?
item.description:
How did the moose begin the letter to his cousin?
Dear Deer.
